case: PostgreSQL custom enum writes with quoted identifiers under shadowed search_path

assertions: The target and shadow schemas each define a same-named quoted enum and rows table; search_path leads with the shadow schema.
Catalog metadata and generated keyed update use the fully qualified, escaped target enum identifier.
The keyed write and structured filter select the target-only label and preserve the target sibling field.
A shadow-only enum label is rejected with native SQLSTATE 22P02 and rollback leaves target and shadow rows unchanged.
pg_typeof reports the qualified target type and quoted unqualified shadow type as PostgreSQL prints them under this search_path.

remaining: Other PostgreSQL enum identifier/session combinations and the broader engine, consumer, and configuration matrix remain open.
